seed_is: the ratified registration's own hash, pre-registered in cordis-sdg at seq 119 before this script was run
method: order the population ascending by (sha256(seed + ':' + id), id); take the first 150; positions 1-50 are development, 51-150 are evaluation
population_source: field 0 of project.csv, read through scripts/read_projects.py
digest_definition: sha256 of the id list, one id per line, no trailing newline
